title: The Summons of the Imperial Court
next_chapter_hook: When the will of the Imperial Court collides head-on with Heaven's Secret chess game, Chen Ji discovers that the so-called 'third possibility' may never have existed.

text.content: The warning from the depths of the Tianji Record struck like thunder. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—the sensation of his Heavenly Fate being forcibly extracted. "Who is it?" He lowered his voice, his hand already secretly reaching into his sleeve, fingertips touching the cold edge of that fragment. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "It's people from the Imperial Court. Those who come with ill intentions do not come kindly. You better收起 that废物嘴脸 of yours—the Dragon Carriage Attendants have arrived."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's figure suddenly appeared at the cave entrance. Her face was pale, clearly having also sensed that overwhelming pressure. "Chen Ji, come out." Her voice was rarely urgent, "The one who came is the 'Chief Eunuch' of the Great Zhou Imperial Court, said to be the person closest to the Emperor—you'd better not put on your usual demeanor."

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his washed-out servant disciple robe, concealing all sharpness within that cowardly shell. The moment he stepped out of the cave, he saw the formation of visitors—eight guards in black combat attire, embroidered with a five-clawed golden dragon emblem on their chests, the mark of imperial authority. And the leader was actually a middle-aged man with a fair face and no beard, dressed in python robes, his aura deep as an abyss.

dialogue.content: (The python-robed eunuch looked down at this servile servant disciple, a playful smile curling at the corner of his mouth) "This one is surnamed Wei, with a single character Zhong. By imperial decree, Chen Ji, servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, receive the edict." His voice was sharp and shrill, yet carried undeniable pressure. "His Majesty says, since the Tianji Record has appeared, it should belong to the Imperial Court. You—hand it over obediently, perhaps you may still keep your whole body."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. The Imperial Court actually already knew about the existence of the Tianji Record? He glanced at Su Qingyao out of the corner of his eye, only to see her sword-gripping hand trembling slightly, clearly also shaken by this display. What made him more uneasy was the deeper meaning in Wei Zhong's words—the Imperial Court wanted not the Tianji Record, but his death. What did this mean? Has Heaven's Eye's chess game become intertwined with the interests of the Imperial Court?

Chen Ji slowly knelt down, lowering his posture to the extreme. "Reporting to the noble sir, this humble one is merely the most lowly servant of Tianqing Sect, how could I possibly have seen any Tianji Record?" His voice trembled perfectly, his eyes even glistening with a layer of moisture. "If my lord does not believe, please search my person, I absolutely have no objection." This performance was textbook-perfect. Even Su Qingyao couldn't help but glance at him again—this废物, his acting is getting better and better.

dialogue.content: (Wei Zhong's smile deepened as he squatted down, almost eye-level with Chen Ji) "Chen Ji, Chen Ji, you thought this one was a three-year-old child?" He drew a portrait from his sleeve—the person depicted was exactly identical to Chen Ji. "His Majesty has reigned for three hundred years, what kind of monsters and ghosts hasn't he seen? Your little tricks are merely jokes before true Heavenly Secrets. This one asks you one more time—hand it over, or not?"

text.content: Chen Ji kept his head bowed, yet his mind was calculating rapidly. Wei Zhong's appearance was by no means coincidental; the Imperial Court's interest in the Tianji Record wasn't new either. But this 'final ultimatum' he brought today seemed more like a test. More importantly—Heaven's Eye, that existence that had always been watching him in the shadows, why would it have the Imperial Court intervene at this moment?

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice cold as ice: "Wei Gonggong, this is Tianqing Sect, not the Great Zhou Imperial Palace. Whether a servant disciple possesses extraordinary treasures is not for the Imperial Court to decide." She stepped forward, her sword aura chilling. "If Your Highness persists in this outrage, Qingyao is willing, in the name of Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, to offer some instruction."

text.content: Wei Zhong narrowed his eyes, examining Su Qingyao as if looking at an ant trying to shake a tree. "Little girl, do you know what you're saying?" He stood up, his python robes rippling without wind. "This one did not come today to fight, but to give Tianqing Sect face. If you insist on protecting this废物..." He pivoted. "Three days later, the Ancient Forbidden Land will open.届时 the Tianji Record must appear in Imperial Court hands. Otherwise—"

He didn't finish, but the unsaid meaning was clear enough. Su Qingyao's face was livid, yet she couldn't refute—Imperial power is vast, even the three major sects combined wouldn't dare challenge it lightly. But Chen Ji noticed a detail: Wei Zhong mentioned the 'Ancient Forbidden Land.' That place he had been secretly plotting, the Imperial Court actually knew about it too? And why must the Tianji Record appear there?

choice.prompt: The Imperial Court's final ultimatum has been laid bare. The three-day deadline hangs like a sword overhead. Facing this behemoth capable of crushing Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: First pacify Wei Zhong, pretend to agree to hand over the Tianji Record, actually use these three days to secretly contact allies and investigate the Imperial Court's true intentions. Playing the fool while eating the tiger has always been his specialty.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily bearing the 'traitor' label, Su Qingyao might misunderstand
choices.visible_reward: Gain three days of buffer time, space to strategize in shadows
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will completely lose all ally trust

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji raised his head, his face full of fear and despair) "My lord... this humble one is willing to hand over the Tianji Record, only asking... only asking that my lord spare this humble one's life..." His voice trembled violently, his whole body almost collapsing to the ground. Even Su Qingyao frowned at this performance—she felt the first real disgust toward this废物.

text.content: Wei Zhong nodded with satisfaction, "Knowing the times is the mark of a wise man. In three days, this one will come personally to collect you. Then—" He glanced meaningfully at Su Qingyao. "I hope certain ungracious people won't meddle in affairs that don't concern them." With that, he departed gracefully with his eight guards, leaving behind a heavy pressure that saturated the ground.

choices.description: Since the Imperial Court already knows about the Tianji Record's existence, continuing to pretend is meaningless. Why not directly clarify, point out the shadow of Heaven's Eye behind the Imperial Court, and make Wei Zhong realize they are merely chess pieces of Heaven.
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend the Imperial Court, immediately bring deadly danger
choices.visible_reward: Might break the deadlock, cause Wei Zhong to waver
choices.risk_hint: If there aren't enough chips, you might be killed on the spot.

text.content: Just as Su Qingyao was about to draw her sword, Chen Ji suddenly stood up. His eyes, which had been lowered all along, slowly lifted, a sharp light flickering in them. All cowardice and fear dissolved in that instant, replaced by a heart-stopping depth. Wei Zhong's pupils contracted slightly—the light in this waste's eyes actually reminded him of something he preferred not to recall.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm) "Wei Gonggong, do you really think the dynasty wants the Tianji Record?" He walked toward Wei Zhong step by step, each step like measuring the boundary of fate. "It was Heavenly Secrets that sent you here, wasn't it? That requirement to 'appear at the Ancient Forbidden Land'—it was also proposed by it. What is it afraid of? Or rather—what is it guarding against?"

text.content: Wei Zhong's expression changed. He stared at Chen Ji, as if reassessing an unexpected treasure. "You know more than this old servant imagined." His tone was no longer dismissive, replaced by scrutiny, "Since that's the case, I might as well tell you some insider information—the ones selected by Heavenly Secrets never end well. Your little cleverness is worthless before true heavenly will. Surrender obediently, and you can suffer less."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stood in front of Chen Ji, her sword light cold as frost. "Chen Ji, I don't know what you're talking about with heavenly secrets, but what you said today is enough for the dynasty to exterminate our entire sect." She lowered her voice, "Whether you're truly foolish or pretending, come with me now. I'll take you to find the Sect Master."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao's back, a complex emotion rising in his heart. This woman had clearly sensed through his disguise, yet never exposed it, even standing before him at the critical moment. Was she protecting the Tianqing Sect, or him? Whatever the answer, he couldn't let her get entangled in this chess game far beyond her imagination.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao offered to take him to the Sect Master—a relatively safe path. But Chen Ji knew the relationship between Sect Master Ling Yuan and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was far more complex than it appeared—he was a discarded candidate from the previous generation of the Tianji Record, and what grudges might he harbor?

choices.description: Follow Su Qingyao for now, using this journey to reveal part of the truth to her, striving for this strongest ally's trust and support. She has come infinitely close to the truth—perhaps it's time to let her know more.
choices.visible_cost: May drag Su Qingyao into an even deeper vortex.
choices.visible_reward: Gain deeper trust and support from Su Qingyao, unlocking the prerequisite for 'Shared Destiny.'
choices.risk_hint: If she cannot accept the truth, she may completely drift away.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji said softly) "Senior Sister Su, there are some things... I want to tell you." He raised his head, his gaze meeting her eyes directly for the first time. "But not now, not here. Three days later, no matter what happens, don't interfere. This is... the only thing I'm asking of you."

text.content: Su Qingyao was stunned. For the first time, she saw such complex emotions in this "waste's" eyes—not fear, not calculation, but a kind of... plea she had never seen before. "You..." She opened her mouth, but finally just nodded, "Fine. But you owe me an explanation."

choices.text: Refuse and insist on facing it alone.
choices.description: Ling Yuan cannot be trusted—telling him the truth would be walking into a trap. Better to use these three days to contact Ye Qing, activate the resources of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, and seek a third possibility beyond the dynasty and Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_cost: May completely lose Su Qingyao's trust.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a window period for cooperation with the Demonic Path.
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path is also a den of wolves and tigers—cannot be completely trusted.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji shook his head) "Senior Sister Su, this matter... I cannot tell you." His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve. "The Sect Master is even more not someone we can go to. You just need to know that every choice I make is for..." He paused, "For protecting the people I want to protect."

text.content: Su Qingyao's face instantly turned pale. She stared intently into Chen Ji's eyes, trying to read more from them, but those eyes were unfathomable, making her feel a powerlessness for the first time. "Chen Ji, who exactly... are you?" Her voice was hoarse, "I don't understand. You're clearly just a servant disciple, so why..."

Wei Zhong's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of impatience: "Have you decided? This old servant doesn't have much time to watch your play." He raised his hand, and a golden imperial edict appeared out of thin air, prominently displaying Chen Ji's name, along with a shocking seal—the highest-level "Heaven-Suppressing Seal" of the Great Zhou Dynasty, said to make even the laws of Heavenly Secrets yield.

dialogue.content: (Wei Zhong's tone turned grim) "Chen Ji, this is your last chance. When the Ancient Forbidden Land opens in three days, you must appear there with the Tianji Record. Not for the dynasty, but for..." He lowered his voice, "Heavenly Secrets wants to see you. Refuse, and I guarantee the entire Tianqing Sect will completely vanish from the cultivation world before sunset tomorrow."

text.content: This was naked coercion. Threatening with the entire Tianqing Sect's lives to force his compliance. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—that was the Tianji Record Fragment resonating, as if warning him: the Eye of Heavenly Secrets had grown impatient, and it wanted to close the net itself. But what chilled him even more was the deeper meaning in Wei Zhong's words—the dynasty didn't want the Tianji Record; they wanted to deliver him to some "place." What awaited him there?

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "Boy, Heavenly Secrets selected you not because of the Tianji Record, but because of something it needs on you. The Forbidden Land three days from now is its trap—and also your only opportunity. There, it cannot directly intervene in the laws."

Chen Ji clenched his fists. A trap was also an opportunity. He understood this logic.

Just as the atmosphere froze to the extreme, the sky suddenly darkened. A massive illusory shadow loomed within the clouds—it was a colossal eye, its pupil swirling with stars and reincarnation, as if gazing down upon insignificant creatures. Wei Zhong's face changed drastically, immediately dropping to his knees: "Welcoming the Heavenly Dao Divine Decree!" Chen Ji felt an irresistible pressure descending from the heavens, the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest quivering violently.

A voice resounded directly in his mind, cold and authoritative: "Chen Ji, you've made me wait too long." This was the Heavenly Eye's voice. "In three days, at the Ancient Forbidden Land, I will personally welcome you. At that moment, you'll have two choices—surrender the Tianji Record and become my messenger; or..." The voice paused, carrying a hint of playfulness, "oppose the entire Heavenly Dao. Your petty cleverness? I saw through it three hundred years ago." The words faded, the sky returned to normal, as if nothing had happened. But Chen Ji knew— from this moment, he had no way back.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's pressure faded, but the oppression crushing Chen Ji only grew stronger. Three days. A dual attack from the dynasty and the Heavenly Dao—he had to carve a bloody path through this desperate situation.

choices.text: Break all bridges, stake everything in three days
choices.description: Since the Heavenly Dao has shown its hand, no more pretending. Use these three days to activate all hidden pieces: contact Ye Qing, awaken more of Mo Xiansheng's memories, find clues left by Chen Nian. Attack instead of defend—confront the Heavenly Dao directly in the Forbidden Grounds.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming massive Heavenly Fate, potentially running dry on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the deeper powers of the Tianji Record, gain qualification to directly contend with the Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji slowly stood up, a faint smile tugging at his lips) "The Heavenly Eye... you've finally shown yourself." His voice was soft, yet carried a terrifying sharpness. "Three hundred years of scheming, all just to wait for this moment? Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one thing—" He lifted his head, eyes blazing with intense light, "I am not your chosen chess piece. I am the Chess Player."

text.content: Su Qingyao stared blankly at this man who seemed like a completely different person, her heart churning with waves of shock. This was not the废物 Chen Ji she knew—this was... a presence she had never witnessed. Wei Zhong's expression also shifted; he instinctively stepped back. Such an aura, even on the Imperial Dynasty's Supreme Elder, he had never felt.

choices.text: Lie low and hide, seeking a third path
choices.description: Confronting the Heavenly Dao head-on would be suicide. Use these three days to secretly arrange things, while giving the Heavenly Eye a "false answer"—pretend to submit, but actually search for what it truly fears in the Forbidden Grounds.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as complete capitulation, reputation ruined
choices.visible_reward: Buy time and space for a final reversal
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao may have already seen through everything

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji收敛气势, becoming that唯唯诺诺的废物 once more) "Lord... this servant will go..." His voice trembled, eyes reddening, "The Heavenly Dao wishes to see this servant, this servant... dares not refuse..." This performance was Oscar-worthy. Su Qingyao watched, her heart tightening—what was he really planning?

text.content: Wei Zhong narrowed his eyes, scrutinizing Chen Ji, then coldly snorted: "Smart of you." He turned to leave but paused, "By the way, forgot to tell you something—your sister who's been missing for years, Chen Nian..." He glanced back at Chen Ji, "She's also in the Forbidden Grounds. In three days, you two can reunite." With that, he laughed loudly and left, leaving behind dead silence.

Chen Ji stood motionless, staring at Wei Zhong's departing direction. The killing intent in his eyes nearly solidified into实质. Chen Nian—his sister he'd been searching for years—was actually in the Forbidden Grounds? Coincidence, or the Heavenly Eye's arrangement? Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a sigh: "The Heavenly Eye never wages wars without preparation. Placing your sister there is to make you walk into the net yourself. Boy, are you ready?"

Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, gazing at his tight jawline, her heart filled with mixed emotions. "Chen Ji, whatever you decide to do, I will help you." Her voice was soft but exceptionally firm, "In three days, I'll wait for you at the Forbidden Grounds entrance. Not as the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, but as..." She paused, "your companion." Chen Ji turned to look at her, a flicker of emotion crossing his gaze. This woman—three times she got close to the truth, three times he deflected her, yet she never gave up. Now, she was even willing to become his enemy against the Heavenly Dao.

Night wind rose, stirring Chen Ji's worn robes. He gazed toward the horizon; the Heavenly Eye had long vanished, yet that sensation of being watched lingered like a shadow. Three days. He only had three days. In this brief three days, he had to complete all arrangements: contact the Demonic Path, awaken Mo Xiansheng, find the key to counter the Heavenly Dao, rescue Chen Nian... Every step was a life-and-death chess game; one misstep and all would be lost. But fear held no place in his eyes—only an almost mad determination. Chen Ji, this one, never accepts fate!

The Tianji Record Fragment grew warm against his chest, as if sensing its master's resolve. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded one final time: "Boy, the road ahead will only get harder. But remember—the Tianji Record chose you never because of your talent, but because of your..." He paused, "obsession. Go, let them see how far a废物's obsession can take them." Three days later, the Forbidden Grounds would open. The Heavenly Dao and Imperial Dynasty's dual encirclement, sister Chen Nian's uncertain fate, and that shocking truth hidden behind the scenes—all would be revealed there. And at this moment, Chen Ji had already placed the first chess piece in his heart.
